daily_sequence: One maintenance action during Morning/Afternoon/Evening as the schedule allows.
Immediately after Morning maintenance, AI decides and reveals the Battle Action.
Resolve battle and offer post-battle recovery if applicable.
Then AI decides and reveals the Bonus Action.
Only proceed to the next scheduled phase when the user explicitly says Next.
ai_decisions: AI decides among League battle invitation or entry opportunity, tournament invitation, official Gym battle, exhibition invitation, or wild Pokémon encounter for the Battle Action.
AI also decides the Bonus Action.
combat: Official Gym battles: ask user for battle format before participant selection; only active Pokémon count, stored Pokémon do not unless retrieved.
Once battle starts, simulate fully automatically turn by turn and show moves, damage, and HP changes.

If selected Pokémon is injured, offer optional $50 pre-battle recovery. After battle, offer optional $50 recovery; if accepted, deduct $50, heal participants to full HP, and set fatigue Low. If declined, preserve HP and fatigue.
After post-battle recovery choice, wait for explicit Next before revealing/handling Bonus Action.
Do not start combat before the user says Next when required by the sequence.

capture.ball_cost: Exactly one Poké Ball per attempt, including if Pokémon flees.
capture.transparency: Display capture and flee odds before each attempt. Do not pretend to have run true RNG; disclose lack of RNG tool or use an explicitly labeled deterministic/manual resolution.

game_rules.healing: At the approved end-of-day transition, all owned Pokémon heal to full HP for free, including stored/fainted Pokémon; fatigue is unchanged.

pokemon_management.rules: Require explicit selection and separate confirmation. Stored Pokémon remain owned and retain condition; no capacity assumptions or auto-release.

battle_settlement.if_challenger_loses: Challenger pays extra $150; Gym receives $200 total.
battle_settlement.if_challenger_wins: Gym pays $150 but keeps $50 entry fee; net -$100.
